name: Brisbane BNE2 (ex-iseek Brisbane Airport stage 2 / LDR2)

address.note: Sources differ: 2 Cycas Lane (master.csv/datacentermap) vs 4 Cycas Lane (fire engineering report describes the Stage 2 building at 4 Cycas Lane, source 4). 4 Cycas Lane may be the correct lot for the Stage 2 building.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '2 Cycas Lane, Brisbane Airport QLD 4008' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Cross-check: the OpenStreetMap building footprint ('DigiCo BNE1, 2, Cycas Lane, Brisbane International Export Pa') is 27m away.

builder.note: Project builder per A.G. Coombs case study (A.G. Coombs mechanical D&C subcontract awarded Dec 2019). Note FDC's own 'iSeek Data Centre' project page (4m, 3,380 sqm) appears to describe the original ~2010 iseek DC (BNE1), not LDR2.

developer.note: Developed by iseek; acquired by DigiCo Infrastructure REIT (HMC Capital) in 2024 as part of the iseek acquisition.

mw_it.note: 6 MW design figure from Feb 2019 announcement; DigiCo reports much lower installed IT (~1.7 MW per master.csv notes).

cost_aud_m.note: The widely cited $44m iseek data centre figure relates to the original Brisbane Airport DC (~2010), not LDR2.

authority.note: site on leased federal airport land (Brisbane Airport Corporation) so approval presumably under Airports Act 1996 via BAC, not council; not confirmed

pathway.note: Airport land: approval via BAC/Airports Act rather than council; not confirmed.

construction_start.note: Announced Feb 2019 targeting Q1 2020 completion; mechanical subcontract awarded Dec 2019. Actual start not found.

construction_end.note: Practical completion 'late 2020' per contractor case studies; original target was Q1 2020 (source 2).

open_questions: address: 2 vs 4 Cycas Lane for the Stage 2 building
installed IT (~1.7 MW) vs 6 MW design; confirm >=5 MW design
